title: VAST Version
description: Supported VAST (Video Ad Serving Template) specification versions. Covers every version published by IAB Tech Lab, through VAST 4.3 (released December 2022). The value mirrors the `version` attribute a VAST document declares on its root element.
$comment: VAST 4.3 ships no XSD of its own: IAB's `vast_4.2.xsd` remains the authoritative schema for 4.3 documents, so a validator MUST NOT reject a tag declaring `version="4.3"` for want of a 4.3 schema. VAST 4.4 is deliberately absent because `vast_4.4.xsd` is annotated 'DRAFT for working group discussion' and is not a published specification; add it once IAB publishes it, not before. This file is the single source of truth for the roster, per the Enum Consolidation rule in docs/spec-guidelines.md, and other schemas `$ref` it rather than restating the list.
